title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a soil picker to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app has a free soil pressure slider; beginners would like named soils (soft clay, firm clay, dense sand).

## Context
The lesson already has typical ranges in `SOIL_RANGES`; they are teaching values only.

## Expected outcome
Presets or labels that set the slider to the middle of each typical range, with a note that they are not design values.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Three named soils selectable
- [ ] The not-for-design note is visible

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: neighbouring footings and overlapping bulbs
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; the shipped code only gives the stress under the centre of one footing.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Real footings sit close together and their stress bulbs overlap.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: staged loading and combined footings
body:
## Problem
Session 3 applies the load in one step and handles one column per footing.

## Context
Roadmap milestones 2 and 3: superposition of consolidation curves and a combined footing for two columns.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the load is applied in steps and a two-column footing is sized.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both roadmap checkpoints met
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a footing loaded in steps
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a footing loaded in steps with a pressure bulb, a settlement curve and the consolidation curve; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Bulb contours agree with the closed-form stress under a rectangle within 1 percent
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
